notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.7. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelatedElement += OwnedExpression` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens; its whole content is a full OwnedExpression, not anything narrower, which is what admits the comparisons and arithmetic that appear as loop and branch conditions. Narrowing it would be the kind of range restriction a parser generator wants and the language does not state.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
Line 7 `if i < 0 {` holds the comparison as this member; line 20 `while i > 0 {` the same in a loop head; line 22 `} until b;` a bare feature reference as the until condition.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
